description: This file defines a custom Doctrine ORM function for calculating time differences between two datetime expressions, supporting different units (minutes, hours) in SQL queries.

classes.name: TimeDiff
classes.description: A custom Doctrine ORM function node for computing time difference between two datetime expressions in specified units.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the arguments passed to the TimeDiff function in Doctrine ORM DQL, extracting two datetime expressions and a unit type.

methods.name: getSql
methods.description: Generates the SQL fragment for the time difference calculation based on the parsed arguments and the specified unit (minute or hour).
